name: Network CN Inc.
summary: Network CN Inc., together with its subsidiaries, provides out-of-home advertising services in the People's Republic of China. The company also operates a network of roadside light emitting diode (LED) digital video panels, mega-size LED digital video billboards, and light boxes. In addition, it provides administrative and management services. The company was formerly known as Teda Travel Group Inc. and changed its name to Network CN Inc. in August 2006. Network CN Inc. is headquartered in Tsim Sha Tsui, Hong Kong.
